videos.desc: On the small stage of a basement theatre with brick walls and string lights, a young woman in a black polo neck and trousers sits on a wooden chair and leans far back with wide eyes and flying hair, as if caught in a storm. A man holds an electric fan towards her and a woman on a ladder pours water from a watering can, while a man plays an upright piano. She then sits up and shades her eyes with one hand, looking into the distance. The audience in the front rows laughs and covers their faces.

At a night festival a man with his hair in a bun, in a dark short coat and trousers, stands in a wide lunge on a wet wooden stage and strikes the skin of a giant drum on a red stand with a thick wooden stick, so that dust and spray fly off the drumhead. He swings the stick high over his head, hits the drum again and shouts. Paper lanterns glow on a string above, a wooden shrine gate stands in the smoke behind, and spectators crowd the edge of the stage.

At an outdoor music festival at dusk under a stormy grey sky, a smiling man in a black T-shirt with headphones around his neck pushes up a fader on a large mixing desk, and its rows of level meters glow brighter. Beyond a barrier a huge crowd raises their arms towards a stage lit by spotlights and haze, where a band plays. A young woman in the crowd cheers with a raised hand. Then the man, grinning widely, cups a hand to his mouth and shouts towards the stage.

In a bright art restoration studio a young woman in a white lab coat and purple gloves, with a magnifying visor on her head and a pencil in her hair bun, dabs an old dark oil painting on an easel with a small cotton pad. As she wipes, bright blue sky and then a figure in a red robe appear under the brown dirt. She gasps, steps back and smiles with delight. A tray of cotton swabs, jars and a colour chart lie on the table, and other restorers work behind.

On the deck of a small fishing boat on a rough grey sea, a young woman with a long braid, a grey fleece and orange waterproof bib trousers braces her feet and fights a fish with a strongly bent rod, the thick end of its handle pushed into a holder at her hip. A big wave crashes over the side and water rushes across the deck. An older man in yellow oilskins comes out of the cabin and holds out a landing net. A bucket of small silver fish, cool boxes and ropes sit on the wet deck.

On a rooftop terrace in an old town at sunset, a young woman with a red flower in her dark hair, a black top and a long red ruffled skirt dances flamenco with her arms raised, holding wooden castanets in her hands, then spins so that her skirt swirls out and laughs. Beside her a young man in a white shirt sits on a wooden box drum and plays a guitar, smiling. Pigeons fly up from the tiled roof behind them, pots of geraniums stand on the wall, and church domes and a bell tower rise in the distance.

A smiling young woman with a black bob and fringe, a mustard cardigan and a long olive dress stands beside a tall wooden-framed standing mirror. Next to her, white shelves are crowded from floor to ceiling with dozens of old porcelain teapots with painted flowers. She touches a teapot on a high shelf, then turns and spreads her arms proudly towards the shelves. Two friends laugh on a sofa behind her, more teapots stand on a table, and open cardboard boxes with bubble wrap sit on the floor.

At a snowy ice festival at night, a young woman with long blonde braids, a red snowsuit, a fur trapper hat with red ear protectors and gloves stands in the snow with both arms raised, shouting with joy. A chainsaw lies at her feet. Behind her rises a huge castle carved from ice and lit in purple and blue, and a crowd stands behind metal barriers. She lowers her arms, turns round and looks up at the ice castle as the crowd cheers.

In a theatre with gilded balconies, a young woman with dark hair in a bun, black-rimmed glasses and a black suit sits in the front row with a serious, unimpressed face, writing notes in a small notebook with a pen. She adjusts her glasses, presses her lips together and keeps writing. All around her the audience roars with laughter, and a man next to her wipes tears from his eyes. A rose and a programme lie on the edge of the stage in front of her.

A busy board-game cafe. A young woman with curly black hair, a black sweater and gold necklaces has just thrown a white die with black spots; it flies through the air, lands on a board game with a winding path and wooden pawns and rolls to a stop while she gasps and puts a hand on her chest. A second die, cards, glass tokens and a phone lie on the table, and a bowl of popcorn has tipped over. Behind her two friends hold their heads, and shelves of game boxes and pendant lamps fill the room.

The deck of a sailing boat at sunset. A wooden record player on the cockpit table plays a black vinyl record that spins round, and a seagull stands right next to it, bending down to look at the record, then lifting its head and opening its beak. A stack of record sleeves with a pink seashell on top sits on the bench, another black record lies on the wooden deck, and two enamel mugs stand in holders. Coiled ropes, winches and a golden sail surround them, and a lighthouse is on the horizon.

In a bright brick workshop with tall arched windows, a young man in a linen shirt and leather apron holds up one piece of amber glass with a number on it against the light and checks it. Then he lowers it and lays it carefully on its outline on a numbered paper pattern, next to a half-finished stained-glass panel of blue, green and orange pieces. A soldering iron, a coil of lead strip and a tin of nails lie on the bench, and a young woman behind him looks up and smiles.

On a film set on a rainy cobbled street, a young woman in a brown old-fashioned coat and hat with a paper tag pinned to it stands silently in a line of people in similar period coats and hats behind a rope. A brown hat falls through the air and lands on the wet stones. The view moves closer to her face as she looks down and closes her eyes. Further back, under a big tarpaulin and bright film lights, two actors in suits stand with a crew member holding an umbrella next to a rail of costumes.

At a hobby desk in a warm lamp-lit room, a young man with curly hair, round glasses pushed up on his forehead and a green cardigan paints a tiny model of a man in a green jacket with a fine brush. He lifts the little painted man up close to his face, studies it, then sets it down on the desk. Rows of unpainted grey miniature people stand on the table, a small glass dome covers another model, paint pots crowd the desk, sketches hang on a cork board and a tabby cat sleeps on a stool.

On the stage of a grand concert hall, a young woman in a long emerald green dress holds her cello high above her head with one hand and laughs with joy, her other arm wide open, while flowers fly through the air. She lowers the cello, hugs it to her chest and then bows deeply over it. Behind her the orchestra in black stands and applauds, and the conductor claps on his podium. Petals, her bow and an empty cello case lie on the wooden floor, and a packed audience fills the hall.

In a picture-framing workshop with a canal outside the window, a young woman with a long braid in a linen shirt and blue apron presses a painting of lemons on a branch into an ornate gold wooden border on a workbench, then steps back smiling. An old man in a cardigan holds his face in both hands, delighted, and then claps. Sample corner pieces in many colours cover the walls, a mitre saw stands behind, and a jar of nails and wooden strips lie on the bench.

A young woman with long braids tied up in a bun and a mustard jumper bends close over a detailed model village on a table. With a thin needle and steady fingers she fixes a tiny part onto a thatched stone cottage, while a tube of glue lies on a green cutting mat beside a small matchbox. Three young women sit by a tall window with a view of a church and watch quietly. Then she jumps up and cheers with both fists, and a laughing young man in a denim jacket leans in beside the table.

A young woman with curly dark hair, sunglasses, a white shirt and denim shorts stands on a stone quay in a small sunny fishing harbour with blue and white boats. Holding a hot glue gun, she presses a scallop shell onto the upturned wooden hull of an old rowing boat, which is already half covered in rows of seashells, and then lifts the glue gun again. Crates and buckets full of shells stand around her, a cable lies across the ground, a seagull stands by a crate, and two young men watch from behind.

Inside a wet fish market hall, a young woman with pinned-up red hair, in a long dark green velvet dress and green heels, sits on a stool and plays a tall golden harp, swaying as she plucks the strings, with a pair of yellow rubber boots beside her. Behind her, men in orange waterproof overalls stand at steel tables piled with fish and shellfish on ice and sing along, one holding up a big fish. Hanging lamps light the hall, steam drifts in the air and a seagull sits on a beam.

A cobbled city square at sunset under pink clouds. A young woman with a braid, in khaki cargo trousers and a short jacket, pulls a canvas sheet off a huge sculpture of a whale's head made of welded bicycle chains, gears and scrap metal, and it falls to the ground. She raises both arms in triumph, shouts with joy and then puts her hands to her face, while a fountain jet rises higher behind the whale. A crowd holding coffee cups cheers and claps, ladders and a toolbox stand beside her, and pigeons fly up from the wet cobbles.

A golf course by the sea at golden hour. A young woman in a cream cap with sunglasses on the peak, a cream polo shirt and beige trousers swings her golf iron through and follows through high over her shoulder. She then laughs and lowers the club. A golden retriever stands beside her with another iron in its mouth next to a white golf bag. Two men in caps watch from behind, one holding up a sheet of paper, with dune grass, seagulls and the sea in soft evening light.

A small jazz club in a brick-vaulted cellar. A woman with her locs tied up in a knot, wearing a grey satin shirt and black trousers, plays a brass trumpet under a spotlight, a music stand in front of her. She lowers the trumpet, smiles at the man beside her who plays a tall wooden double bass, and then lifts it to her lips again. In the foreground a young man plays a snare drum with brushes. The audience sits at small round tables lit by candles in jars.

In a dim art gallery, a tall wooden stand holds a thin, stretched, milky plastic sheet, lit from behind by a spotlight. A young woman with long platinum hair, in a long black dress, presses against the sheet from behind with her palms raised and her eyes closed, and pushes her face further into it, so that the thin sheet stretches and wrinkles around her hands and face. At the left a young man in the shadows covers his mouth in surprise. A floor light and coiled cables lie nearby.

A record pressing factory. A young woman in a navy work coat and white cotton gloves lifts a large metal tape reel high above her head and looks up at it, then lowers it and holds it in front of her, looking at it and speaking, while a big crowd of workers watches from the back of the hall. Beside her a young man in ear defenders works a pressing machine. Black vinyl records run along a conveyor, tall stacks of white sleeves stand nearby, and an open tape case lies on a trolley.

In a small tavern with white walls, old posters and hams hanging from a beam, a male flamenco dancer with long dark hair, a short black jacket, black trousers and heeled boots dances on a wooden stage under a spotlight. He stamps his boot so that dust flies up from the boards, then turns, swings his arms and spins with one arm raised high. A guitarist plays behind him, and the audience at small round tables with candles and wine glasses claps and cheers with open mouths.

In a pottery workshop in an old wooden barn, a woman with her hair tied back, in an apron over a denim dress, sits at a spinning wheel and shapes a tall grey clay vase with wet, clay-covered hands. The view starts very close on her hands inside the vase and moves back until the whole workshop is visible. Beside the wheel are a bucket, a sponge and small tools. Behind her another person works at a second wheel, shelves hold rows of pots and an orange kiln glows by the sunlit barn door.

By a stone fountain in a sunny town square, a smiling young man with black hair, in a cream knitted jumper and a chain necklace, holds a wooden cross of strings and makes a painted wooden puppet boy in a striped suit dance on the fountain's rim. The puppet kicks up a leg, bows towards a grey pigeon standing next to crumbs, and reaches a hand out to it while the pigeon stares at the puppet. Water sprays from the fountain, and friends and an old man watch and laugh.

At a town square festival at sunset with bunting and balloons, a young woman in a safety harness leans out from a raised metal lift platform and gently lowers one long wooden block onto the very top of a giant stacking-block tower much taller than a person, with sawdust puffing out. She lets go, pulls back her hands and holds on to the railing, staring at the tower. A bald man in the platform watches, and below a large crowd stands tense, many with their hands at their faces.

A big workshop with brick walls and roof windows, where a team builds a giant red and gold dragon sculpture on a wooden platform. A young woman in dungarees paints its head from a ladder, climbs down, then climbs back up and paints again. A man sands its side and a young woman in a green jumper yawns and drinks from a coffee cup. Two more workers sleep on the concrete floor among paint tins, coffee cups and a pizza box, and pale pink dawn light shows through the windows.

A bright art studio with white brick walls and paint-splashed windows. A young woman in paint-covered white trousers and a rust-coloured top throws a huge wave of blue paint from a tin onto a big canvas full of orange and pink swirls, and the paint runs down onto the floor. She laughs and throws her head back. A young man in a paint-spotted T-shirt paints the top of the canvas from a stepladder, and other young people stand at easels in the back with a plaster bust and tables of paint.

A comedy club with a bare brick wall and dark red curtains. A young woman with long red hair in a black blazer stands on a small stage in a spotlight, holding a microphone and acting out a joke with a straight face. In the audience at small candlelit tables people laugh loudly: a young woman in blue spills her drink and bends over to pick up the glass, and a young man in a cream jumper laughs so hard that he leans forward out of his chair. Glasses and candles stand on the tables.

A wet old-town square with a stone fountain in spring. Two street drummers dressed exactly alike, in yellow bucket hats, yellow vests and black trousers, leap high into the air at the same moment with their drumsticks raised, land, and crouch to drum on two matching sets of upturned blue plastic buckets with cymbals. Then they stand up, laugh and tap their sticks together. A crowd of young people claps and cheers, pigeons fly up from the fountain, and café umbrellas line the square.

Under a concrete motorway bridge at night, with graffiti on the pillars and coloured string lights. A young woman in a red jacket and black trousers balances in a one-hand freeze on a square wooden dance mat, her legs high in the air, then springs up to her feet. Behind her a big crowd of young people in bright tracksuits cheer with raised arms, a young man in blue bows down to the ground in front of her, and she points at the camera with a big smile. A speaker stands beside the mat.

A cosy pub with dark green tiles, a roaring fireplace and paintings of horses. A young woman in a dark red top leans over a wooden table, eyes fixed on a tall wooden block tower, and carefully pushes out one block with a single finger. Behind her two friends shout, wave and gasp to distract her, one holding a paper bag, but she never looks up and then points at the tower. Drinks and a bowl of crisps sit on the table, and a spaniel under it wakes and lifts its head.

A slackline stretched high across a deep gorge full of autumn trees in red, orange and yellow, with a river far below. A young woman in an orange top, black leggings and a climbing harness walks barefoot along the middle of the line with her arms spread wide, balancing about halfway between the two rocky cliff tops. A young man in a green fleece sits by the anchor on the near rock, watches her, smiles and shades his eyes, and a young woman in a mustard jacket crouches on the far side.

An outdoor concert at dusk. A young woman in a blue satin top, jeans and white trainers climbs over the metal crowd barrier onto the stage with a huge smile, helped by a young man in a white T-shirt. A young female guitarist in a mustard shirt holds out a microphone to her, and a young singer in a black shirt reaches out to welcome her. She takes the microphone and starts to sing at the front of the stage, while the young man below cheers with his fist up. Coloured spotlights shine from the stage.

An empty park field on a misty autumn morning at sunrise. A young man with curly hair in a brown jacket gets up from a folding camping chair, spreads a tartan blanket on the grass, then sits down on it alone and leans back, his breath steaming in the cold air. Behind him a big outdoor concert stage is still being built: a yellow crane lifts a metal lighting rig into the air, and metal fences stand around the stage. City towers are visible in the haze and fallen leaves cover the grass.

An attic with wooden beams, a skylight and a work lamp. A large model railway fills a big table: tiny fields, hedges, houses, a tunnel and a station are carefully arranged, and a red steam train puffs smoke as it crosses a stone viaduct and disappears. In the foreground two hands with mint nail polish and lilac sleeves set a small fir tree onto a green hill. A young man in navy dungarees leans across the table, places a tiny piece on the far side and looks up with a smile.

A rooftop swimming pool on a sunny day. A young woman in a blue bikini and a young man in navy swim shorts jump off the edge at exactly the same moment, knees tucked up, facing each other and smiling. They hit the water together with a big splash, then come up side by side in the pool, laughing. A lifeguard in red sits on a tall white chair by a pale blue wall with round windows, other swimmers stand nearby, and loungers, awnings and palm trees line the terrace above.

An old theatre stage with a gold arch and red velvet curtains. A young woman in a long gold sequinned gown stands in the centre in a bright spotlight, arms raised high, laughing. Then she lowers her arms and presses her hands to her chest, smiling at the audience. Behind her two dancers in black move in the blue shadows, one kneeling at the end, in front of a painted night city backdrop. Footlights line the front of the stage and the heads of the audience show in the foreground.
